citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper says Ibn Khaldūn, as a Maliki judge and Mamluk official, attempted to have Ibn Turka and his fellow Brethren in Cairo executed as sorcerers and that his grudge was personal; it cites Gardiner and MK's own earlier papers, not the dissertation.
refers_to_primary: Gardiner, Ibn Khaldūn versus the Occultists; Melvin-Koushki, In Defense of Geomancy
